newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - touch easier with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - touch easier with crude.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was seen to have weakened in line with softer crude.

The market was seen to be balanced with about four cargoes seen available matched against four potential buyers. Dealers said low sulphur straight run would track crude closely and offers were heard as low as $122-123 fob NWE.
Although crude was still seen expensive against products, straight run was still not cheap enough to be substituted.
"With crude at today's level we would have to see $117 fob for that," commented one trader. High sulphur straight run was also a touch weaker showing formula +$4-$4.50.
